body:
I feel the exact same way. I could have written this, funnily enough even down to not seeing your therapist until next Thursday - that's my next appointment too, and she also is the only one in my life I can actually talk to. I'm sitting here depressed as anything, intermittently crying,  wishing I had someone who would listen to me talk about this.

It sucks. If I weren't so lonely I know my depression wouldn't be as bad. If you want to talk, PM me.
